sources.title: Rell Build Guide: ✔️ How pocovirtuoso got Rank 1 Rell in World with this Setup ✔️

passive.name: Break the Mold
passive.text: Rell's Attacks and Abilities deal additional magic damage and steal Armor and Magic Resist on hit.

spells.name: Shattering Strike
spells.text: Rell deals magic damage to units in a line, breaking their shields and stunning them.

spells.name: Ferromancy: Crash Down
spells.text: Mounted: Rell Dismounts, crashing down in her armor, Knocking enemies up and gaining a large Shield. While dismounted, she gains Armor, Magic Resist, Attack Speed, and Attack Range, but is Slowed.Dismounted: Rell forms her Mount, gaining a burst of speed and Knocking Up the next enemy she attacks.

spells.name: Full Tilt
spells.text: Passive: Rell gains out of combat Move Speed.Active: Rell and an ally gain ramping Move Speed, doubled toward enemies and each other. Her next Attack explodes, dealing magic damage.

spells.name: Magnet Storm
spells.text: Rell explodes in a magnetic fury, violently Pulling nearby enemies toward herself. Then Rell constantly Drags nearby enemies toward herself for a short while, dealing magic damage over time.

damage.value: Rell deals burst magic damage with her attacks and abilities and sustained magic damage during Magnet Storm.

archetype.value: Rell is a tanky playmaker support who uses crowd control to set up fights and peel.

axis.value: Rell plays lane aggressively, looking for all-ins when enemies misposition.

winCondition.value: Rell wins by controlling vision, gaining a lane lead through coordinated engages, and snowballing that lead.

spikes.why: Rell can pull nearby enemies in and drag them toward herself while dealing magic damage over time.

bait.why: When Rell spends Shattering Strike, its shield break and stun are unavailable until it comes off cooldown.
When Rell spends Crash Down, its knockup and large shield are unavailable until it comes off cooldown.

mistakes.value: Rell risks enemy ganks when she neglects vision control.
Rell loses lane pressure and risks ganks when she neglects vision control.
